abstract: Evaluates medical response times and arctic survival shelter equipment
system_message:
You are the Expedition safety and health director (SAF), responsible for evaluating medical response capabilities, emergency evacuation infrastructure, and arctic survival shelter equipment across candidate exploration base camp plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Emergency medical evacuation（MEDEVAC）
information_points.content:
SAF-MEDEVAC-K7Y：For the Mackay Lake Pre-Fabricated Container Hub, the emergency crushed-rock landing strip provides an all-weather medevac strip length of 1050 m certified for Twin Otter air ambulance landings.
SAF-MEDEVAC-EPU：For the Lac de Gras Modular Skid Camp, the emergency crushed-rock landing strip provides an all-weather medevac strip length of 850 m certified for Twin Otter air ambulance landings.
SAF-MEDEVAC-N3M：For the Contwoyto Lake Insulated Geodome Complex, the emergency crushed-rock landing strip provides an all-weather medevac strip length of 1250 m certified for Twin Otter air ambulance landings.

information_points.title: Evaluates medical response times and arctic survival shelter equipment（MED）
information_points.content:
SAF-MED-F51：For the Mackay Lake Pre-Fabricated Container Hub, the redundant standalone emergency survival refuge provides a hypothermia survival shelter autonomous heating endurance of 120 h, measured as continuous passive and catalytic heating endurance without external generator connection at minus 40 degrees Celsius.
SAF-MED-F0N：For the Contwoyto Lake Insulated Geodome Complex, the redundant standalone emergency survival refuge provides a hypothermia survival shelter autonomous heating endurance of 72 h, measured as continuous passive and catalytic heating endurance without external generator connection at minus 40 degrees Celsius.
SAF-MED-IDB：For the Lac de Gras Modular Skid Camp, the redundant standalone emergency survival refuge provides a hypothermia survival shelter autonomous heating endurance of 72 h, measured as continuous passive and catalytic heating endurance without external generator connection at minus 40 degrees Celsius.
